title: Private Decision Brief
description: A short private metacognitive checkpoint used before building a public Jev request. This object is never serialized verbatim. Prefer piping it to build-decision-packet.mjs through stdin and avoid durable storage.
$comment: OBSERVE, UNCERTAINTY, DIRECT-CHECK, STOP. Add INFER, ASSUME, COUNTER, PREDICT, FALSIFY, and DISCRIMINATE only when they clarify the current route. Export only the decision-relevant summary produced by scripts/build-decision-packet.mjs; never a hidden reasoning transcript.

observations.description: What is directly known, with source IDs when available.

assumptions.description: Optional premises connecting observations to the current belief.

strongest_counter.description: Optional strongest plausible alternative or objection.

prediction.description: Optional precommitted result expected by the current belief before an empirical check.

falsifier.description: Optional observation that would weaken the current belief; omit for non-testable classifications.

discriminating_observation.description: Optional observation that best separates testable alternatives.

action.description: Required by the builder when available=true; execute it instead of calling Jev.

jev_will_change_action.description: False means stop deliberating and do not call Jev.
